# Run log

The run log of one case: one line per event, each carrying its sequence number, the SHA-256 of the line before it, the instant and the event; and the refusals a reader gives a log that was cut, has a line missing or out of order, or has a changed byte.

`loom.runlog` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `ActionFinished`

`loom.runlog.ActionFinished` is a record of six fields:

- `action` — `String`
- `exit` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `refusal` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `blob_digest` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `evidence` — `List<String>`
- `revisions` — `List<loom.runlog.RevisionMove>`

### `ActionStarted`

`loom.runlog.ActionStarted` is a record of one field:

- `action` — `String`

### `AuthorityRecorded`

`loom.runlog.AuthorityRecorded` is a record of three fields:

- `capability` — `String`
- `decision` — `String`
- `principal` — `String`

### `CaseOpened`

`loom.runlog.CaseOpened` is a record of two fields:

- `case` — `String`
- `protocol` — `String`

### `ChildClosed`

`loom.runlog.ChildClosed` is a record of two fields:

- `child` — `String`
- `outcome` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `ChildOpened`

`loom.runlog.ChildOpened` is a record of two fields:

- `child` — `String`
- `protocol` — `String`

### `Discarded`

`loom.runlog.Discarded` is a record of two fields:

- `action` — `String`
- `reason` — `String`

### `Evaluated`

`loom.runlog.Evaluated` is a record of three fields:

- `case_revision` — `Integer`
- `frontier` — `String`
- `decision_digest` — `String`

### `RevisionMove`

`loom.runlog.RevisionMove` is a record of three fields:

- `artifact` — `String`
- `from` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `to` — `String`

### `RunLogEvent`

`loom.runlog.RunLogEvent` is one of 10 shapes, told apart by a `kind` field — tagged, so a decoder never has to guess which branch it is reading:

- `ActionFinished` — `loom.runlog.ActionFinished`
- `ActionStarted` — `loom.runlog.ActionStarted`
- `AuthorityRecorded` — `loom.runlog.AuthorityRecorded`
- `CaseOpened` — `loom.runlog.CaseOpened`
- `ChildClosed` — `loom.runlog.ChildClosed`
- `ChildOpened` — `loom.runlog.ChildOpened`
- `Discarded` — `loom.runlog.Discarded`
- `Evaluated` — `loom.runlog.Evaluated`
- `Stopped` — `loom.runlog.Stopped`
- `Terminated` — `loom.runlog.Terminated`

### `RunLogLine`

`loom.runlog.RunLogLine` is a record of four fields:

- `seq` — `Integer`
- `prev` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `at` — `Timestamp`
- `event` — `loom.runlog.RunLogEvent`

### `RunLogRefusal`

`loom.runlog.RunLogRefusal` is one of `CutLine`, `BrokenChain` and `SequenceGap`.

### `RunLogRefused`

`loom.runlog.RunLogRefused` is a record of three fields:

- `refusal` — `loom.runlog.RunLogRefusal`
- `line` — `Integer`
- `detail` — `String`

### `Stopped`

`loom.runlog.Stopped` is a record of two fields:

- `stop` — `String`
- `next` — `List<String>`

### `Terminated`

`loom.runlog.Terminated` is a record of one field:

- `reason` — `String`

Two of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `loom.runlog.RunLogLine` and `loom.runlog.RunLogRefused`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
